TAK Server API

  • TAK Server API spec (Redoc, versioned) — the authoritative reference: https://docs.tak.gov/api/takserver
    • Raw OpenAPI per version: https://docs.tak.gov/api/takserver/<version>/openapispec.json (this guide tracks 5.6-RELEASE-14).
    • Public; ~300 operations under /Marti/api/….
  • TAK Server source (U.S. Government / TAK Product Center): https://github.com/TAK-Product-Center/Server
  • TAK Server Configuration Guide (official; civilian) — the authoritative reference for ports, certificate/TLS security, group assignment (input / auth-message / x509 client-cert), authentication backends (File / LDAP), OAuth2, federation, and device profiles. The facts on ports, the __ANON__ default group, the CN→username→group mapping, and the :8446/oauth/token endpoint in this guide come from it.

Deploy App (OpenDefence / pvarki)

  • Deploy App Core API (RASENMAEHER) — the enrollment/cert/token API used here. Its OpenAPI ships in this repo at public/api-specs/rasenmaeher/ and is served in the site's embedded API reference. Source: pvarki/python-rasenmaeher-api.
    • Key surfaces: /api/v1/enrollment/*, /api/v1/product/sign_csr (+ /renew_csr, /revoke/mtls), /api/v1/token/jwt/*, /api/v1/firstuser/*, /api/v1/check-auth/*. Auth schemes: JWTBearer, MTLSHeader, MTLSorJWT, ValidUser.
  • Related Deploy App docs (this site): What is Deploy App, Architecture orientation, the Develop Deploy App and Build an Integration books.
  • TAK wiki pages (this site) — operator/admin view of the server-side concepts this guide integrates with: Takserver Groups, Keycloak – Group Management, Mission Manager (Data Sync) (Mission Manager UI at :8443/Marti/MissionManager.html; defaultRole / Groups), Takserver RECON feed, Device Profiles, and Update Server (OTA).

Key concepts referenced

  • Cursor-on-Target (CoT) — the TAK event format (see the ATAK plugin guide's CoT in depth).
  • mTLS — mutual-TLS client-certificate authentication.
  • OIDC / Keycloak — OpenID Connect identity, consumed by TAK Server's OAuth API.

Scope & sourcing

This guide points to the public TAK Server API spec and describes the civilian integration surface, combined with OpenDefence's own Deploy App Core API and docs. No TAK-MIL / restricted material is reproduced. Endpoint names are a map to the specs — the specs are authoritative for exact request/response shapes, and both TAK Server and the Deploy App API are versioned, so confirm against the version you target.
